decisionPrice: Exact parent latest causally available closed market price at or before decision timestamp; finite positive numeric; age in [0,5] wall-clock minutes; no future substitution or filling. Gate uses decisionPrice, never Entry price.

measurement.inputs: Exact saved Development checkpoints and frozen deterministic 5m adapters; no provider acquisition, no fit, no new 1m study. Reconstruct only required unavailable full candidate evaluator rows; retain new immutable derived audit inputs.
measurement.opportunity: Exact parent same-session future 5m HIGH +1/+2/+3/+5, CLOSE confirmation. High touch is not fill. Outcome availability never gates selection.
measurement.metrics: Parent evaluator precision on evaluable selections plus all-selected lower bound; hits/decision; P>=1 lower bound; recall and timestamp-matched random lift within each arm eligible universe. Also common old universe recall for denominator-transparent comparison.
measurement.replacement: Record excluded old Top5 and new identities with original eligible rank, new eligible rank, score, decisionPrice; retain old/new identities; do not pair replacements as causal outcomes.
measurement.downstream: When safely available, invoke unchanged two-opportunity frozen Entry on new selection stream with identical source-event and first-per-symbol-session admission semantics; reuse saved old outcomes. Report actual fills as NOT_MODELED, reference eligibility separately. If exact new replay unavailable, label retained-only sensitivity explicitly and never call it complete new population.
measurement.mae: Exact previous strict30 contiguous six completed5m/no-lunch definition; old complete vs new complete with coverage; distinguish retained, removed, added/replacement paths; never infer EXIT solved.
robustness: 4 chronological blocks by 76 frozen session order
same fixed top3 frequency exclusions from OLD selections
measurement.performanceGate: None. No price threshold sweep, no utility/precision-based winner selection. Freeze is policy/integrity acceptance only.

freezeGates: unchanged frozen predictive logic and price semantics
dedicated tests and relevant regression pass
new dedicated CI pass and artifact reviewed
existingCandidateCFailure: Existing CC freeze KILL audit remains failure; never weaken it or interpret it as failure of this independent policy implementation.
stop: After impact audit and FREEZE or DO_NOT_FREEZE evidence. No Entry/EXIT research or deployment follows.
